attr.title: NHL 94 SNES
attr.desc: EA Sports NHL '94 for Super Nintendo, rebuilt in C, hosted by Overbar. Overlay on Select. Original cartridge speed by default. Bring your own US dump.
attr.inst: Copy your NHL '94 SNES ROM into nhl94s/roms/nhl94.smc (internal header NHL '94 at $7FC0, map $30). A 512-byte copier header is fine.
